output.explanation: Expanded snapshot because its Diagram values and display panes hide substantial nested composition. The central tree retains document/canvas ownership; diagram-value expands immutable content, parsed nodes and source evidence, while display-state expands pane ownership and variant payloads. Cross-links preserve selection capture, source-mapping consumption and external view-state ownership. Checked the pinned checkout's model types, selection synchronization, controller, session/workspace, history service, persistence adapter and editor runtime. Source-backed refinements identify domainProfileId, grid:<boxId> view keys, optional legacy parser versions, and the distinction between stored revision IDs and captured content revision IDs. Core, archive, agents and commands remain exactly unchanged: they already focus on their respective lifetimes and boundaries. All existing edges are retained. Archive and agents move right only to make room for the new peripheral diagrams.

diagrams.ascii:
Mapping application - lifetimes and semantic ownership
|
|-- App services (createMappingServices; shared through context)
|   |-- canvasHistory: DefaultCanvasHistoryService -> [archive]
|   |-- workspaceStorage: WorkspaceStorage -> [archive]
|   `-- diagramGenerator / codeRepo (HTTP service adapters)
|
`-- MappingPocPage / MappingServicesContext.Provider
    `-- MappingWorkspacePage (page lifetime; /evals is a separate consumer)
        |-- CanvasWorkspace
        |   |-- controllers: Map<documentId, controller> (session references)
        |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
        |   |   |-- DraftMetadata: name, repository, saved baseline, viewport
        |   |   `-- CanvasSession (one per document)
        |   |       |-- CanvasCursorCopy
        |   |       |-- Read-only observable stores
        |   |       |   |-- document / presentation / selection / controls
        |   |       |   `-- geometry (bounds, cell, version) / status (dirty, undo)
        |   |       |-- Saved baseline + cached scene/edge keys
        |   |       |   `-- updateBaseline(acknowledged save); sceneDirty = scene only
        |   |       |-- Commit listeners -> workspace.onPersist(ids)
        |   |       `-- MappingDocumentController
        |   |           |-- CanvasEditingContext handle -> shared history service
        |   |           |-- ControllerSnapshot -> [snapshot]
        |   |           |   `-- document: MappingGridDocument / canvas: MappingCanvasState
        |   |           |-- Command facade + publication -> [commands]
        |   |           |   `-- applyUpdate / transact / updateCanvas / undo
        |   |           `-- Optional editor driver (attached reference, not editor ownership)
        |   `-- setDrafts(): create sessions; replacement/removal unsubscribes + disposes
        |
        |-- MappingEditorCanvas (mounted per rendered draft; not session-owned)
        |   |-- tldraw Editor: live geometry, camera, native undo navigation
        |   `-- MappingEditorRuntime (holds editor/controller references)
        |       |-- publish(): snapshot -> mapping-box shapes + checkpoint metadata
        |       |-- settle(): completed gesture -> controller.commitEditorGesture()
        |       |-- Native checkpoint change -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint()
        |       `-- dispose(): settle, remove listeners and detach editor driver
        |           (pointer/camera frames do not commit semantic document state)
        |
        |-- SourcePaneViewState: personal camera/pane state -> persistence
        |-- WorkspacePersistence adapter -> [archive]
        |-- PromptComposerCoordinator -> [agents]
        |-- useAgentCanvasBridge + DiagramRevisionReceiver -> [agents]
        |-- Storage reference: injected App service; page-owned fallback if absent
        `-- Startup: representations + storage.load() -> reconcile -> setDrafts()

Archive and durable records - collaborating owners
|
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (App-shared; not owned by a controller)
|   `-- contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|       `-- CanvasHistory (isolated per handle)
|           |-- CanvasHistoryRecord
|           |   |-- headId / baselineId / past / future
|           |   |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|           |   |   |-- CanvasDocument: composition without embedded contents
|           |   |   |-- diagramBindings: local content key -> revision ID
|           |   |   `-- view / nodeOrigins / optional linked transactionId
|           |   |-- diagramRevisions: retained exact revision records
|           |   `-- canvasViews: named recordings outside undo-restored state
|           |-- document(): composition + bindings + revisions -> resolved document
|           |-- append / navigate / fork / adopt; persistenceChanges(cursor)
|           `-- Transfer preparation: linked source/destination checkpoints
|               `-- Ordinary undo rejects linked boundaries; use workspace undo
|
|-- diagramRevisionStore (module API; shared, not a session-owned table)
|   |-- createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram / resolve by revision ID
|   `-- internal revisionRegistry retains revisions
|
|-- WorkspacePersistence (page-owned translation adapter)
|   |-- Per-session cursors / known drafts / subscriptions
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) + SourcePaneViewState changes
|   |   `-- Read: controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) + metadata/baseline/view
|   `-- Record batches -> WorkspaceStorage.records.batch()
|       (share content-addressed items; do not resend unchanged history)
|
|-- WorkspaceStorage (App service; owns transport resources)
|   |-- records: RecordStorage
|   |   |-- Cache + coalesced pending keys + one in-flight batch
|   |   `-- requestId + expectedRevision; retries keep batch identity
|   |-- workspaceStorage.worker: encode records and POST workspace/records
|   |   `-- HTTP: /api/mapping/workspace/records -> WorkspaceRecordStore.apply()
|   `-- flush(): await acknowledgement; dispose() alone is not a flush
|
`-- WorkspaceRecordStore (server-side durable owner)
    |-- Serialized apply(): receipt check before expected workspace revision
    |-- Validate records; reject mutation of immutable revisions/items
    |-- Content-addressed JSON record files
    `-- Atomic manifest replacement publishes references, revision and receipt

Agent-assisted editing - producers outside session ownership
|
|-- Page-owned PromptComposerCoordinator
|   |-- Entries, drafts, exact captured requests, polling timers
|   |-- submit() -> client.capture(): pin version and baseRevisionId
|   |   `-- Call: client.start() -> DiagramEditService.start()
|   `-- status / cancel / retry exact request; independent of selection and undo
|
|-- DiagramEditService (backend application service)
|   |-- runs + request-ID deduplication; abort/pending state
|   |-- Generate from canvas snapshot, pinned references and AgentContext
|   |   `-- Call: DiagramGenerator + stored revision APIs -> exact revisions
|   `-- DiagramEditCanvasPort.snapshot / apply / create
|       `-- Live canvas command transport; no ownership of the controller
|
`-- Page-owned live command ingress
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge
    |   |-- Register ephemeral canvas; poll commands -> page handler -> replies
    |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and unregisters this instance
    `-- DiagramRevisionReceiver.apply() / batch()
        |-- Expected canvas version + expected base revision
        |   `-- Call: controller.applyUpdate() (same semantic boundary as UI)
        |-- Retain request receipt before persistence; retries do not edit twice
        `-- Page persistence callback: sync affected document + storage.flush()
            `-- Acknowledge only after flush; failure = PERSISTENCE_PENDING

ControllerSnapshot - resolved state held by each controller
|
|-- Checkpoint identity: contextId / canvasRevisionId
|-- Runtime metadata: version / canUndo / canRedo / endpointBounds / cell
|-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |   |-- root: GridBox (recursive composition)
|   |   |   |-- Common: id / position / minimumSize / collapsed / collapsedContentId
|   |   |   |-- Container: children[]: GridBox + push-right layout / gap
|   |   |   `-- Diagram instance: contentId -> sibling contents table
|   |   `-- contents[contentId]: immutable Diagram -> [diagram-value]
|   |-- edges: DiagramConnection[] / jumps: CanvasJump[] / sections
|   |-- alternatives: items / selected / panels
|   |-- diagramPresentations / diagramContexts
|   `-- revisionSelections / revisionReviews
|
`-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
    |-- selection: SelectionState
    |   `-- items[]: ordered membership, not panel ownership
    |       |-- id / displayNodeId (whole instance when region is absent)
    |       `-- Optional captured region
    |           |-- Source identity + ASCII / rect / contentNodeIds / selectedIds <- Diagram
    |           `-- -> syncSelectionPresentation(): copy captured context into display panes
    |-- controls: MappingControls
    |   |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
    |   `-- surfaces[key]: selection actions / prompt / ask / phase / status
    |-- viewport / projectionLayout (optional checkpoint settings)
    |-- display: DisplayState (separate pane ownership tree) -> [display-state]
    `-- diagramViews[grid:<boxId>]: DiagramViewState (optional table)
        |-- contentRevisionId / collapsedContentNodeIds / collapsedNodeRefs
        |-- display: regular or diff / baseRevisionId
        `-- Derivation: presentationScene(document) -> resolveDiagramView(scene, views)
            |-- -> reads Diagram.content; folding belongs to the instance, not the content
            `-- Visible rows map to raw lines; source ASCII is not rewritten

MappingDocumentController - command and publication internals
|
|-- Held coordination state (beside ControllerSnapshot)
|   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext + reference to historyService -> [archive]
|   |-- pendingNodeIds: correspondence across staged edits
|   |-- listeners / nodeCache / layout measurements / captured viewCamera
|   `-- editorDriver?: settle / undo callbacks -> mounted MappingEditorRuntime
|
|-- Semantic command entry points
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates here
|   |   |-- -> editorDriver.settle(); clear pending node correspondence
|   |   `-- applyOperations(): reject stale version; clone document + canvas
|   |       |-- Stage edits / layout / connections / variants / contexts
|   |       |-- -> stored revision APIs for exact immutable Diagram values
|   |       `-- Validate scene and selections; -> updateSnapshot(record=true)
|   |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
|   |   `-- Same staging path, or record canvas-only gesture as one checkpoint
|   |-- commitDocument / commitProjectionLayout / select
|   |   `-- -> settle attached editor; publish recorded semantic state
|   `-- updateCanvas(value, record=false)
|       `-- Default: transient, no append or version increment; record=true is supported
|
|-- updateSnapshot(next, record, increment=true)
|   |-- Sync selection presentation; prune deleted instance membership
|   |-- Recorded document changes: reconcile edges/jumps; validate connections
|   |-- Normalize diagramViews; resolve floating/conversation geometry
|   |-- If record: -> historyService.append(context, document, canvas, node IDs)
|   |-- Resolve stored revision values; replace snapshot / invalidate changed bounds
|   `-- -> listeners synchronously (session stores and mounted editor runtime)
|       `-- Session detects changed canvasRevisionId -> workspace.onPersist(ids)
|
|-- Navigation (restores archived state, does not append an edit)
|   |-- undo(redo): -> attached editor driver; otherwise historyService.navigate()
|   `-- restoreEditorCheckpoint(id): navigate history to native checkpoint
|       `-- -> updateSnapshot(record=false); linked transfers require workspace undo
|
`-- History access through the context handle (archive is NOT controller-owned)
    |-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyService.persistenceChanges()
    |-- forkHistory / prepareTransfer / prepareTransferNavigation
    `-- Named views / generation / exportHistory -> shared history service

Diagram - immutable value held in scene.contents[contentId]
|
|-- Identity
|   |-- id: local canvas content key
|   |-- diagramId: stable service identity / revision: sequence
|   `-- revisionId: exact stored revision ID -> resolved through shared revision store
|-- content: DiagramContent
|   |-- revisionId: content identity, distinct from Diagram.revisionId
|   |-- ascii / asciiSha256
|   `-- structure (tagged union)
|       |-- kind=diagram: optional ascii-graph-1 parserVersion
|       |   `-- Content nodes are derived; missing parserVersion preserves legacy parsing
|       `-- kind=tree
|           |-- parserVersion: ascii-tree-1 or ascii-tree-2
|           |-- rootIds: ordered root node IDs
|           `-- nodes[id]: DiagramContentNode
|               |-- id / label / line / branchColumn
|               |-- startColumn / endColumn: first-line anchor, not full multiline geometry
|               |-- lines[] (optional): line / startColumn / endColumn text spans
|               |-- parentId / childIds: tree relationships
|               `-- foldRanges[]: startLine / endLine -> instance view hides these rows
|-- sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext
|   |-- binding (optional): DiagramSourceBinding
|   |   |-- sourceId / repositoryIdentity / corpus
|   |   `-- domainProfileId: source-code or document
|   |-- contentHash: must match content.asciiSha256
|   |-- mappings[]: DiagramElementMapping
|   |   |-- id / entityId / sourceRangeIndex / optional sourceRangeId
|   |   `-- line / startColumn / endColumn: diagram-local region
|   |-- evidence[id]: ProjectRepresentationEvidenceRecord
|   |   |-- id / handle / label / category / summary / optional sourceId
|   |   `-- sourceRanges[]
|   |       |-- id / path / optional symbol and compactionId
|   |       `-- startLine / endLine / originalLines: captured source text
|   `-- -> diagramSource(): join mappings to evidence and source ranges
|       `-- -> code-panel handleNodeSelect() consumes these joined ranges
`-- Optional diagram-local decorations
    |-- highlights[]
    `-- jumps[]

DisplayState - pane ownership inside MappingCanvasState.display
|
|-- rootIds: top-level pane IDs (no parent pane)
|-- nodes[id]: FloatingPane
|   |-- Common fields (DisplayNodeBase)
|   |   |-- id / childIds: nested pane ownership, NOT selection membership
|   |   |-- position: x / y; bounds: width / height
|   |   |-- coordinateSpace: canvas or viewport (unscaled CSS pixels)
|   |   |-- expansion: expanded or collapsed
|   |   |-- geometryPolicy: placement automatic/manual; sizing content/fixed
|   |   `-- expandedGeometry (optional): restore allocation after collapsed header
|   `-- Variant payload (one of)
|       |-- SelectionRegion (kind=selection)
|       |   |-- sourceBoxId / sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId / sourceAscii
|       |   |-- rect / contentNodeIds / selectedIds: captured context only
|       |   |-- displayMode: stacked/chained / activeChildId
|       |   `-- <- syncSelectionPresentation() copies SelectionItem.region
|       |       `-- sourceRevisionId captures Diagram.content.revisionId, not stored revision ID
|       |-- ProjectedPane (kind=projection)
|       |   |-- title / projectionId / sourceRevisionId / targetRevisionId / activeChildId
|       |   `-- content (one of)
|       |       |-- call-tree: result: ProjectionSelectionResult / coverage
|       |       |-- compaction: files[]: ProjectedFile
|       |       |-- source-code: SourceCodePaneContent
|       |       |   |-- projectId / sourceId / sourceFile / showCompactions / rangeIndex
|       |       |   |-- files[]: ProjectedFile (projection metadata, not navigation limits)
|       |       |   |   |-- sourceFile / sourceId / sourceSha256 / ascii / selectedLineCount
|       |       |   |   `-- rows[] + sourceRanges; optional ranges / compactedSource
|       |       |   `-- scroll checkpoint; live scrolling -> page SourcePaneViewState
|       |       `-- code-panel: selectionId / scroll / panel: PanelContent
|       |           |-- diagramId / revisionId (content identity) / contentHash
|       |           |-- mappedResourceType / selectedNodeIds / unmappedNodeIds
|       |           `-- items[]: ResolvedMapping <- handleNodeSelect(Diagram, nodes)
|       |               |-- resource: source-range (repo / path / lines / rangeSha256)
|       |               `-- origins[]: selected and mapped node IDs/labels + mappingId
|       |-- ConversationPane (kind=conversation)
|       |   |-- presentation: compact/floating/docked / canvasAnchor / draft
|       |   `-- thread: LocalChatThread
|       |       |-- id / title / verbosity / pending / error / progress
|       |       |-- selection: boxId / nodeIds / rect / summary
|       |       |-- messages[]: id / role / text
|       |       `-- context (optional): captured diagram, mappings and source excerpts
|       `-- DetailPane (kind=detail): title / ascii / optional sectionId
`-- Ownership operations (immutable state helpers)
    |-- addDisplayNode(ownerId): attach as child, otherwise append root
    |-- removeDisplayNode(id): recursively remove descendants and ownership links
    `-- Not owned here: arrows <- document.edges; scene boxes stay in LineGridScene
